approved_findings.evidence: Task spec requires the fourth generated button to clear the document and print `finished` with a white border (`task-spec.md:10-14`). `plan-description.md:13-14` instead says pressing the third generated button clears the document and displays `finished` with a black border. This contradicts the task contract and can mislead execution.

Task spec requires an HTML file containing one button (`task-spec.md:10-12`). `plan-description.md:29-30` puts `two initial buttons` in scope, while the inventory and step W01 require exactly one initial button (`work-unit-inventory.md:10`, `work-unit-inventory.md:23`). This leaves the top-level scope internally inconsistent.
